scenes.title: Rochester 2013 Marshmallow Room: broken vs kept crayon promise quadruples wait time from 3 min to 12 min
scenes.era: 2013 University of Rochester Baby Lab & 1972 Stanford Bing Nursery School paradigm

layout.description: Bright minimalist developmental psychology testing room with neutral plaster walls, a child-height oak table and chair at center, a single white porcelain plate holding one cylindrical white marshmallow, a glass jar of worn crayons at the corner, and a solid oak door at right.

positions.who: Preschool participant (clothed matte-white porcelain child mannequin frame with smooth featureless solid matte-white egg-shaped oval head in mustard-yellow knit sweater and navy trousers)
positions.where: seated at the center oak table leaning forearms near the white marshmallow plate
positions.facing: facing the single white marshmallow and right oak door

positions.who: Cognitive researcher (clothed matte-white porcelain figure with smooth featureless solid matte-white egg-shaped oval head in crisp white lab coat over slate-blue blouse)
positions.where: standing beside the table placing the plate down and stepping out through the solid oak door
positions.facing: facing the seated child across the oak table

props.name: single white marshmallow on a white porcelain saucer
props.period_detail: clean cylindrical white confection centered on an unmarked matte-white saucer
props.physical_behavior: sits inches from the child's folded porcelain hands — snatched at 3 minutes after a broken promise or left untouched past 12 minutes after a kept promise

props.name: glass jar of worn stubby crayons vs full wooden organizer tray of fresh markers
props.period_detail: tactile pre-test reliability props used in Kidd, Palmeri & Aslin (2013)
props.physical_behavior: researcher either sets down the rich wooden marker tray as promised or opens empty porcelain palms in apology

actions.verb_sequence: rests both porcelain forearms on the oak table edge inches from the white marshmallow -> either picks up the marshmallow swiftly or folds both hands calmly in lap

reactions.reaction: watches quietly from behind the observation glass noting the fourfold jump in patience after a kept promise

scenes.wardrobe: Child in mustard-yellow knit sweater and dark navy trousers; researcher in white lab coat over slate-blue collared shirt.
scenes.lighting: Bright warm natural laboratory studio daylight.
scenes.recognition_hook: A child alone at a small table staring nose-to-marshmallow — flipped on its head by what happened with a jar of crayons five minutes earlier.

key_visual.description: porcelain child in mustard-yellow knit sweater seated at a minimalist oak testing table leaning elbows near a single white marshmallow on a white plate as a white-coated researcher closes the oak door

scenes.title: Pre-test reliability test: delivering the promised marker tray vs returning empty-handed

layout.description: Same bright testing room five minutes before the marshmallow arrives.

positions.where: standing beside the oak table holding a rich wooden art-supply tray

props.name: compartmentalized wooden tray of fresh colored markers
props.period_detail: clean unmarked wooden craft tray contrasting with two worn crayon stubs
props.physical_behavior: researcher slides the full wooden marker tray smoothly onto the table in the reliable condition

actions.verb_sequence: lifts away the small jar of worn crayon stubs -> sets a full wooden tray of colorful markers onto the table

reactions.reaction: leans upright and reaches calmly for a fresh marker as trust locks in

scenes.wardrobe: White lab coat and mustard-yellow sweater.
scenes.recognition_hook: Proving your environment keeps promises changes delay of gratification by 400%.

scenes.title: Contained Living 4-Color 3D Brain sagittal valuation circuit: nucleus accumbens vs ventromedial & dorsolateral PFC

layout.description: Bright white gallery displaying a Contained Living 4-Color 3D Brain sagittal cutaway on a matte-white pedestal.

props.name: translucent sagittal 3D brain cutaway
props.physical_behavior: crimson-red nucleus accumbens impulse spark trades signals with warm amber-gold ventromedial and electric cyan-blue dorsolateral prefrontal cortex

actions.verb_sequence: fires a crimson-red spark in deep nucleus accumbens -> streams electric cyan-blue value signals down from dorsolateral and ventromedial prefrontal cortex

reactions.reaction: prefrontal cyan-blue pathways stabilize striatal pulses when future value is trusted

scenes.recognition_hook: Your prefrontal cortex calculates expected trust rather than flexing a willpower muscle.
